title: Cylindrical rod
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles and translation vectors set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at (0.01, 0.01) with a radius of 0.01. Draw the second loop as a concentric circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0078. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0199 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Since no rotation or translation is required, proceed to extrude the scaled sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Define a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The resulting cylindrical rod has a length and width of 0.01992424242424242 units and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle with the given center and radius
r = r.center(0.01, 0.01).circle(0.01)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.01, 0.01)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.01)       # Draw a circle with radius 0.01
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)      # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder of height 0.75
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq
import math

# Define the dimensions
length = 0.75
width = 0.02
thickness = 0.02

# Create a workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the front view
r = r.rect(width, thickness)

# Extrude the sketch to create the solid
r = r.extrude(length)

# Define the sketch for the right view
r = r.workplane(offset=thickness, origin=(0, 0, length / 2)) \
     .rect(width, length)

# Cut the solid to match the right view
r = r.cutBlind(thickness)
